art/objects/pack.png.use: Object: sticker pack, plain ball, no face

art/penalty/keeper.webp.use: 3D penalty keeper: 6 frames of 384x360, feet bottom-centre (ready, dive low, dive high, ball held, beaten on the grass, fist pump). Dives go to the left of the picture: mirror for the right. Cell = 2.04 m.

art/penalty/shooter.webp.use: 3D penalty shooter seen from behind: 6 frames of 301x400 (hands on hips, running, wind-up, strike, arms up, hands on head). Key-blue kit (hue 205-260) recoloured to the club colour at load. Cell = 1.84 m.

art/penalty/stand.webp.use: 3D penalty: the stand behind the goal (fans, tifo star, floodlights), edges faded to the night sky.

art/players/hero-back.webp.use: Dribble and tackles, you seen from behind: 6 frames of 313x320 (run with the ball x2, cut with the ball leaning right, slide to the left, down on all fours, pass). Key-blue kit (hue 205-260), repainted to the shirt colour at load (art.ts).

art/players/hero-side.webp.use: Sprint, you from the side facing right: 6 frames of 248x320 (crouched start, run x4, arms up). Key-blue kit (hue 205-260), repainted to the shirt colour at load (art.ts).

art/players/rival-side.webp.use: Sprint, the rival from the side facing right: 6 frames of 292x320 (crouched start, run x4, beaten). Key-blue kit (hue 205-260), repainted to the shirt colour at load (art.ts).

art/players/rival-front.webp.use: Dribble and tackles, the other side facing you: 6 frames of 314x320 (stance, run x2, run with the ball, slide to the left, sat down beaten). Key-blue kit (hue 205-260), repainted to the shirt colour at load (art.ts).

art/players/top.webp.use: Through balls, players from above: 6 frames of 128x200 (standing, run x2, pass, control, arms up). Key-blue kit (hue 205-260), repainted to the shirt colour at load (art.ts).

art/faces/face-0.webp \u2026 face-7.webp.use: The eight bald faces of the face editor: three views of 128x128 (front, side facing right, back). Head 64 px wide, centred, jaw at y=106. The skin is repainted (lib/face.ts).

art/faces/hair-*.webp.use: Haircuts drawn on a green mannequin, cut out and fitted to the faces: short, side, curly, buzz, spiky, long, quiff (free) and afro, mohawk, ponytail, bun, dreads, flattop, fire (wardrobe items). Chestnut, tinted to the hair colour.

art/faces/beard-1.webp \u2026 beard-4.we.use: Beards, same frame: moustache, goatee, full beard, short beard. Tinted to the hair colour.
